answer: Before a voyage begins at dawn, an agent named raven reserves a bonded cargo slot. A shipping market assigns inspectors randomly after that commitment and pays only against unique receipts signed at both ports. New accounts cannot count purchases from their own funding cluster toward reputation. Bonds remain locked through a dispute period, and contradictory signed receipts permit slashing. Splitting into aliases cannot reuse reserved capacity: an attacker must lock additional capital and finance separately inspected deliveries for every extra reward.
